scope: Bounded as-of retrieval no-regression check over the full regression_10 cohort.
important_caveats: This run was intended as a five-case regression, but the prior five-case metadata artifact was absent, so the harness CASE_IDS filter was empty and the run executed the full regression_10 cohort. The directory was renamed to reflect the actual scope.
The result supports keeping the session-level query-time as-of filter because the exercised regression_10 cohort passed with no operational regressions.
This run does not claim broader heldout parity or full event-valid-time temporal fidelity.
